purpose: Canonical, human-readable and machine-readable memory for every Simpledeav video. Read this folder before creating or changing a film.

voice.name: Nathan Cole
voice.rule: Always use SD_VOICE_03 unless the brief explicitly names SD_VOICE_09.

formats.description: Primary short-form film for TikTok, Reels, Shorts.
Dedicated 16:9 recomposition. Never crop, stretch or letterbox the vertical.
Static 4:5 cover image for the feed and archive.

rendering.rule: Design and preview in Remotion Studio only. Do not render video files or 4K output.

rules: Read memory/README.md and memory/process/rules.md before starting a video.
Use SD_VOICE_03 — Nathan Cole by default. Use SD_VOICE_09 — James Carter only when the brief names it.
Start from the house preset unless the brief asks for the Walmart Editorial Pop look.
Every film gets three Studio compositions: vertical, horizontal and cover.
Never render an MP4, WebM, 4K or any heavy export. Browser preview is the delivery.
Every finished film gets a record in videos/<slug>/ with the prompt, description and social captions.
Never commit heavy media. Keep public/audio, public/images and public/video out of Git.
